quant.name: W8A8_DYNAMIC
notes: Declared representation template; retained tensor samples establish selected contracts separately.

metadata.physical_geometry_policy: captured tensor q/B supplied by profiler; graph padding is not re-applied to physical rows
metadata.runtime_recipe_basis: uncalibrated catalog baseline; no high-concurrency EP/MC2 policy transferred

ffn_source_contract.shared_precision: BF16 activation and weight in both low and high row captures
ffn_source_contract.reduction_boundary: one TP sum after routed unpermute and shared gated join
ffn_source_contract.grouped_execution: analytical decomposition; retained arch22 fusion is not modeled or replaced by arch35
ffn_source_contract.change_scope: shared_expert BF16 activation/weight and final TP joined reduction; existing service parameters unchanged

gqa_decode_source_mapping.basis: explicit FAI source-host ownership with analytical staged GQA device execution
gqa_decode_source_mapping.native_evidence_scope: Qwen3.5 TP4 p126976 c1/c4 complete-body FIA rows; the same pinned serving deployment produced the four p65536 q2 sources
gqa_decode_source_mapping.mapping_policy: fai_host explicitly selects the source flash-decode or regular query/head ownership branch; target_cores is the declared launch-grid budget
unobserved_dispatch_fields: native query/key tiles and pipeline slots
gqa_decode_source_mapping.context_policy: Use each source declared context condition and measured B/q; page/table capacity is not an actual sequence length
